raw_sp:
I used to think the stars were watching  
Like they cared where I laid my head  
But they’ve been burnin’ since before names meant anything  
Long before "I" ever said  

We’re a flicker in the furnace 
A whisper in a vacuum scream  
We mapped the heavens with a compass  
Just to feel like we had dreams  

They told us we were chosen
Crowned kings of everything we see  
But the ants beneath my windowsill  
Seem just as proud as me  

I’m not important, and neither are you  
The universe don’t care what we do  
So let’s drink wine in the parking lot  
Skip the part where we try to mean a lot  
Soak up this dumb, chaotic chance  
Spin in the dance, forget the plan  
We’re all just breath in passing weather  
And none of this was built to last forever 

We carved our names into a planet  
Then blamed it when it started to bleed  
Said we’d “conquered nature,” whatever that means  
As if air ever needed to breathe  

We count years like they owe us answers  
But we’re toddlers in cosmic time  
You blink, and your whole species stutters  
Just a footnote on a dying vine  

There’s bacteria that’s older than our gods  
And it never built a thing  
Still it thrives, quiet, unbothered  
While we wage wars for rings  

I’m not important, and neither are you  
The stars won’t shift if we’re untrue  
So let’s break rules with full intention  
Tear down guilt and reinvention  
Toast to dust, to fading light  
To finding peace in being slight  
We’re all just flickers in collapsing space  
And meaning ain’t a thing we need to chase

"Hey, what if the point is that there's no point?  
And we get to make one up, just for fun?"

I tried to feel special—cosmic, divine  
But now I just dance in the grocery line  
There’s freedom in the ordinary  
When you stop pretending it’s legendary

Maybe love ain’t sacred, but it’s warm  
And laughter’s just biology in swarm  
But damn if it don’t feel holy when you’re near  
Even if the stars won’t hear  

I’m not important, and neither are you  
And that's the best news I ever knew  
Let’s scream into the canyon wide  
And laugh when no one says goodbye  
No legacy, no grand design  
Just tiny fires we light in time  
So raise a glass to the great absurd  
The truth is quiet—and rarely heard 

“Isn’t it kinda beautiful?”

and I know, I know
if I ever saw you again
my chest would crack open so slow,
like the first thaw of spring snow

the water’s so loyal
it keeps repeating
everything that left me
is still leaving.

and I know, I know
if I let myself believe
you didn’t mean to go
I’ll stay waiting at the window
til my bones turn yellow
and the world moves on
without me.

it’s humiliating, really

and I know, I know
the sky won’t split itself for us
nothing divine will intervene
grief is just a quiet animal
that sleeps in the sheets 
it doesn’t stalk you in quiet rooms

I walk the same three streets
like I’m tracing a sigil
trying to summon you back
from a life that probably fits you better
but it isn’t this one
it isn’t this one

and I know
I know.

I keep thinking
if I were quieter
if I were gentler
if I was the water instead of the fire 
maybe you would’ve stayed
long enough to see me soften
long enough to see I was trying

and I know, I know
your absence wasn’t personal
it just landed that way
like snow on a grave
the kind of silence
that scrapes the ribs clean

and I know
I know

I’ve been kinder, lately
like a dog that still believes
I can’t stop following you
you could slam the door closed
a thousand times
and I’d still sit on the porch until noon 

I hate how hope behaves
like it’s loyal
and I know
I know 
you don’t think about me
not like this

but I can’t stop
waiting
for a door
that doesn’t open.

and I know
I know
I’m learning to let go
the way winter lets go of branches
slow
reluctant
splinter by splinter

I will do whatever I want.

Thirty-seven doors that won’t unlock  
I shrink to fit the keyhole talk  
They want me louder, brighter, tall  
But I was born to curl and fall  

No spotlight, no flame  
Just me, the wind, and no name  
She said, “You’ll fade,”  
I said, “Good.”

I danced on a snail’s antenna  
Like the world forgot to blink  
No one watching  
But I felt everything  
I didn’t vanish  
I just stopped being big  
Isn’t that the trick?

Salt shaker suite, spoon for a bed  
Quiet enough to lose my head  
No faces, no fake applause  
Only rhythm, only moss  

Ants in line beneath my feet  
Leaf missed me—still felt complete  
She asked, “Are you gone?”  
I said, “Almost.”

I danced on a snail’s antenna  
Like the world forgot to blink  
No one watching  
But I felt everything  
I didn’t vanish  
I just stopped being big  
Isn’t that the trick?

If I’m small, am I free?  
If unseen, do I breathe?  
You can’t lose what you can’t find  
So I left size behind  

I danced on a snail’s antenna  
Tiny stage beneath the sky  
No one clapping  
Still, I touched the high  
I didn’t vanish  
I just chose the quiet  
Small enough...  
To riot

Fold me in half   
I’m still here

------------------------------------------------------------------
🎬
"How to Get Smaller"

He applied for thirty-seven jobs. They all asked if he could stretch himself. He said, “No, but I can shrink.” They laughed, but he was serious. He started shrinking that afternoon.
By Thursday, he fit inside a salt shaker. His cousin (who only sent voice notes) told him shrinking was irresponsible. “You could disappear,” she said. “That’s the point,” he whispered from the lid.
He traveled in pockets, train vents, and spoons left in cafés. Nobody saw him. That helped.
Eventually, he arrived in a garden and met the snail. Not metaphorically. Literally.
He climbed. It was hard to tell if the snail approved. But when he reached the antenna, the wind paused. And he danced.

raw_sp:
Like gentle truth, it doesn’t shout,
It doesn’t rush, it doesn’t doubt,
It doesn’t push, it doesn’t prove,
It simply is — it simply moves.

It’s not a fire that wants to burn,
Not a lesson we must learn,
But something soft that slowly grows,
In quiet ways nobody knows.

Pre-Chorus
It doesn’t need a grand display…

Chorus
Like gentle truth, it finds its way,
Through silent nights and ordinary days,
Not in the words we try to say,
But in the way we choose to stay.

Like gentle truth, it settles deep,
In promises we do not keep,
In moments small, in simple grace,
In how we hold each other’s space.

Verse 2
It’s in the pause before we speak,
In how we listen when we’re weak,
In not pretending, not performing,
In being here when hearts are storming.

It’s in the calm after the rain,
In letting go without the pain,
In not demanding, not controlling,
In something warm, alive, and whole.

Pre-Chorus
It doesn’t force, it doesn’t bind…

Chorus
Like gentle truth… (repeat)

Bridge
Maybe truth is not a blade,
Not something sharp we’re meant to face,
But something kind we slowly see,
When we allow ourselves to be.

Last Chorus (soft)
Like gentle truth, it stays unseen,
Between the words, within the in-between,
Not something loud, not something new,
Just something real — and always true.

The night still clings to my shoulders,
Pearls resting light on my skin.
Last dance smoke in my hair,
A whisper of violins.
Fifth Avenue’s hush is silver,
The windows glitter and sigh.
I watch the diamonds waking—
The city opens its eyes.

My heels remember the ballroom,
Soft echoes under my feet.
The dawn is pale and tender,
Like secrets we never keep.
I tip my face to the shadows,
Behind these dark tinted frames—
The world may call me reckless,
but the morning knows my name.

Maybe I’ll sleep ‘til the evening,
Or wander until I fade—
The day is a velvet curtain
that never asked to be made.
I hum to myself like a memory,
my heartbeat slow and light—
Just letting the city hold me
between goodbye and night.

The pearls fall soft on my collar,
The breeze still carries perfume.
I smile at the quiet jewel-case
Where morning begins too soon.
And here in this hush of amber,
This pause before the day—
I am only a silhouette
the sunlight hasn’t claimed.

The night grows heavy, the bottle low,  
Whispers of music in shadows glow.  
The bar is closed, the lights grow dim,  
But one last call is just for him.

No crowd remains, no voices near,  
Just me and the echo I choose to hear.  

[Chorus]  
Last call for myself, a quiet toast,  
To all the nights I’ve missed the most.

Hoping the music will help me sleep.

The bass walks slow under midnight skies.  
I pour again though the glass is thin,  
A final reminder of where I’ve been.

Every sip tells me it won’t end.  

[Chorus]  
Last call for myself, a quiet toast,  
To all the nights I’ve missed the most.  
I drink to the silence, I drink to the deep,  
Hoping the music will help me sleep.

No bartender, no company,  
Just whiskey and the melody.  
The record spins, the shadows stay,  
Carrying me till break of day.  

[Final Chorus]  
Last call for myself, tender and true,  
One more glass to make it through.  
I drink to the silence, I drink to the night,  
Jazz and whiskey make it right.  

[Outro]  
The bottle sleeps, the record slow,  
Last call for myself, before I go.

[Verse 1]
Here's to the endless drag of days that bleed into the dark,
Sleepless hours where my mind fractures, tearing me apart.
You're right there in the haze, but miles from my reach,
A faint spark in the void, mocking what I preach.  [Pre-Chorus]
We cling like wreckage in the storm,
Two ghosts too stubborn to let go.  [Chorus]
'Cause we're the ones who show up when the world's gone to hell,
Wounded saviors in the fight, ringing our own death knell.
No end in sight to this twisted ride,
Darlin', you're the scar I can't hide.
You're the one true lie I call a friend.  [Verse 2]
Raise a glass to the rot of this world, all the venom and the schemes,
Deceit wrapped in pretty words, chasing hollow dreams.
I'll chain myself to you through the fire and the flood,
'Til my pulse gives out and I'm lost in the mud.  [Pre-Chorus]
We burn like embers in the rain,
Defiant 'til the bitter end.  [Chorus]
'Cause we're the ones who show up when the world's gone to hell,
Wounded saviors in the fight, ringing our own death knell.
No end in sight to this twisted ride,
Darlin', you're the scar I can't hide.
You're the one true lie I call a friend.  [Bridge]
(Heavy breakdown with crushing guitars and screamed vocals)
Scream into the silence, where the promises all break,
We're drowning in the aftertaste of every goddamn mistake.
You pull me from the edge, but drag me deeper in,
This bond's a loaded gun—cocked, and wearing thin.
No angels here, just devils dressed in skin!  [Final Chorus]
(Soaring, layered with distortion and raw intensity)
'Cause we're the ones who show up when the world's gone to hell,
Wounded saviors in the fight, we drag each other through the swell.
No end in sight, but fuck if I'll pretend,
Darlin', you're the poison and the mend.
You're the one true lie—my bitter end, my friend.  [Outro]
(Fading with gritty riff and echoing vocals)
Here's to the long days that never end...
Never end...
My one true friend...

[Verse 1]
I built cathedrals out of matchstick bones,
Prayed to the silence when God was gone.
Every halo I wore turned to rust,

The flesh is weak but the ache’s still sure.

[Chorus – snarled, jagged]
I’m mortal too—
I bleed just like you.

Now the air between us stinks, it’s rotten.
Mortal, mortal—

Love’s just a weapon when you call it a game.
Every vow’s a shadow, every kiss a scar,
You wanted forever—do you know who we are?

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t call me savior, don’t call me divine,
I’m a ghost in the mirror, a blade in the spine.

[Chorus – harsher delivery]
I’m mortal too—
I bleed just like you.
I’m human, baby, you’ve forgotten,
Now the air between us reeks, it’s rotten.
Mortal, mortal—
Say it true:
I’m mortal, and I’m nothing to you.

[Bridge – half-snarled, half-sung]
Carve my name in cathedral glass,
Watch me shatter when the light won’t pass.
Kiss the cracks where the truth bleeds through,
If I’m broken, I’m broken for you.

[Final Chorus – screamed / distorted]
I’m mortal too—
I bleed just like you!
I’m human, baby, you’ve forgotten,
Now the air between us stinks, it’s rotten!
Mortal, mortal—
Poison proof:
I’m mortal, and I’m nothing to you.

[Outro – fading into distortion]
Mortal… mortal…
I’m mortal too.

raw_sp:
I built my life on borrowed dreams
Gave my hands to help them reach
Every smile I carved from pain
I gave it all and asked no gain

Then she came, her eyes like storms
Lost and cold, I kept her warm
Taught her how to stand again
Watched her bloom and fly the wind

But the higher she climbed, the smaller I became
The man behind the curtain, whispering her name

And I’m falling apart
In the wreckage of my heart
All the ones I lifted high
Now they pass me by
She took the sun from my sky
Then blamed me when it died
But I still wish her light
Even as I fade tonight

I gave her dreams, I gave her years
Traded joy for her career
Held her world with calloused hands
Built her throne from broken plans

When I stopped to chase my soul
She called my passion selfish goals
So I laid it down, my songs, my fire
Watched my own reflection tire

Now she wears her crown of spite and gold
And tells our child her father’s cold

And I’m falling apart
In the wreckage of my heart
All the love I gave away
Left me hollow, left me gray
She turned my wings to stone
But I still walk alone
Finding beauty in the small
And the strength to rise from the fall

Where are the voices I once raised
The ones I carried, the ones I praised
They vanished when the lights went down
Left me bleeding on the ground
But I still paint with trembling hands
Still write my name in the shifting sands
And though the world forgets my song
My spirit hums, it still goes on

Yes, I’ve fallen apart
But I’m mending this heart
One brushstroke at a time
In this quiet life of mine
If love should find me still
I’ll give, but keep my will
For even the broken can grow
Where forgiveness starts to show

She lost her glow, I found my peace
And what comes around brings release

--

title: TRIED TO BREAK ME DOWN

raw_sp:
[Intro]

Nah…
I see it now
And it won’t happen again

⸻

[Verse 1]

You never chased me, you let me chase air
Called it patience while you stayed nowhere
You hid behind calm, behind “I’m just me”
Like confusion was some kind of integrity

You’d disappear right when I felt sure
Come back cool like I’d ask for more
I said you were different, gave you grace
Whole time you were just avoiding the weight

⸻

[Pre-Chorus]

You never crossed lines
You erased them
So I did the work
You wouldn’t claim then

⸻

[Chorus]

That’s how you tried to break me down
With your silence, with your ease
But I don’t confuse detachment
With emotional maturity

You tried to break me down
Let me carry all the cost
Now I see you never led
You just watched me get lost

⸻

[Verse 2]

I rearranged my life to match your pace
You stayed still, I filled the space
You never asked for my devotion
But you let me drown in your half-emotion

I called it depth, I called it control
But control don’t mean leaving someone cold
You never lied, but you let me believe
That breadcrumb love was all I’d receive

⸻

[Pre-Chorus]

You stayed unbothered
I stayed aware
Funny how clarity
Feels like air

⸻

[Chorus]

That’s how you tried to break me down
Slow and clean
But I won’t give credit
For love you never gave to me

You tried to break me down
Had me questioning my worth
Now I see the game for what it was
And I’m the one who walked out first

⸻

[Bridge]

You didn’t take my power
I handed it away
But I just took it back
And I won’t stay

I don’t want closure
I don’t want proof
I just want distance
From men who confuse

⸻

[Final Chorus – Empowered]

You don’t get to break me down
Not again, not now
I don’t chase silence
I speak my vows

You don’t get to break me down
I know what I need
And calm without intention
Ain’t peace to me

⸻

[Outro / Ad-Libs]

Yeah… I’m good now
No confusion
No wondering

I wasn’t broken
I was patient
Too patient

That’s the real break down

raw_sp: Know ye the willow tree Whose gray leaves quiver, Whispering gloomily To yon pale river; Lady, at even tide Don't wander near it, They say its branches hide A sad, lost spirit? Once to the willow tree A maid came fearfully, Pale seemed to be her cheek, Her blue eyes tearful; As soon as she saw the tree, Her step moved fleeter, No one was there—ah me! No one to meet her! Quickly beat her heart to hear The far bell's chime Great from the chapel tower The trying time: But the red sun went down In golden flame, And though she looked round, Yet no one came! Presently came the night, Sadly to greet her,— Moon in her silver light, Stars in their glitter; Then the moon sank away Under the billow, Still wept the maid alone— There by the willow! Through the long darkness, By the stream rolling, Hour after hour went on Tolling and tolling. Long was the darkness, Lonely and silent; Shrill came the night-wind, Piercing and chilly. Shrill blew the morning breeze, Biting and cold, Bleak peers the gray dawn Over the world. Bleak over moor and stream Looks the gray dawn, Gray, with disheveled hair, Still stands the willow there— THE MAID IS GONE! Domine, Domine! Sing us a litany,— Sing for poor maiden-hearts broken and weary; Domine, Domine! Sing us a litany, Wail we and weep we a wild misery!

[Verse 1]

You stirred your tea
like it held a secret
No rush
Just motion
The room didn’t ask for speed
So neither did we.

There was nothing pulling us
No beeping, no lines
Just the shape of your breath
And the time
it was allowed to take.

⸻

[Pre-Chorus]

I learned slowness
watching you pour milk
like a prayer
like an answer
without sound.

⸻

[Chorus]

There was nothing urgent
but everything mattered
Your sleeve brushing mine
like a word unspoken
We moved like leaves
in a world that ran
but we
just stayed.

⸻

[Bridge]

It’s not stillness
if you’re listening
It’s not waiting
if you’re present
It’s not late
if you never promised
to arrive.

⸻

[Verse 2]

I kept a rhythm
measured in sips
in silence
in the crease of your smile
when you didn’t need to speak

We didn’t solve anything
but the moment
solved us.

⸻

[Chorus]

There was nothing urgent
but everything clear
No countdown
No beginning
Only here.
We weren’t rushing
toward or from —
just breathing
like it was enough.

⸻

[Outro]

mmm-mm…
not late
not early
just
right
now.

Lately, radio feels alive again,
Miss one show, you’re out of the game.
It’s not the one I knew at ten,
but the waves still call my name.

No screen, no glow, just sound and space—
that static hum, a gentle grace.
When I tune between the stations’ haze,
I find a piece of yesterday.

Old baseball on in a Chinatown shop,
steam and laughter never stop.
Turning the dial, that little click—
my memories hum in the hiss and the mix.

No screen, no glow, just sound and space—
that static hum, a gentle grace.
When I tune between the stations’ haze,
I find a piece of yesterday.

I never thought the noise could stay—
but it’s part of who I am today.

With trembling fingers in the soil
I trace these letters one by one
The rain will wash them all away
Before tomorrow's rising sun

Each grain and pebble moves aside
As childish scrawls take shape below
Like footprints on the cosmic plane
That time and weather overthrow

I mark my presence in the ground
A fleeting moment carved in clay
The wind will scatter what I've found
And steal my markings clean away

The earth accepts my offering
This temporary testament 
To all the days that slip between
The fingers of this moment spent

The garden holds a thousand names
All written, washed, and born again
In endless cycles counting days
Since first we learned to hold the pen

I mark my presence in the ground
These letters etched in morning dew
The earth will turn and turn around
Till nothing's left of what we do

* The songs in GiR: Girls in Reality are all connected by a story, so I hope you enjoy following along.

* Here is the English translation of the Korean lyrics.

Six days since you’ve been away,
wake and run, a busy morning.
No words left to start the day,
out the door, same routine.
Through the subway glass, I see
a shape that feels so close to you.
Just a thought, then it fades,
nothing more I can do.

Half asleep, half aware,
without you, the city’s quiet everywhere.

Same time, same call,
we laugh, we talk, that’s all.
Same time, same call,
your smile inside the screen,
but the warmth won’t reach me.
For a moment, feels close.

Back home again,
light the room, same old spot.
“How was your day?”
“Just… like always.”
A short laugh drifts away,
and silence fills the air.
Our breath feels slightly different now,
a distance I can’t repair.

Sometimes I forget the space between,
but when it ends, it’s there again.
We’re still far away now,
still us, just quieter.

Same time, same call,
we laugh, we talk, that’s all.
Same time, same call,
the lights are fading slow.
Same time, same call,
this is what we are now.

See you tomorrow,
same time, same call.

[Verse 1]

Alarm rings, toast burns, hands in a scramble,
Emails arrive before the kids leave the table,
Mascara smudged, lost shoes, puzzle pieces underfoot,
You’re late again—your boss sends a reminder look.

[Pre-Chorus]

Every app says breathe in,
But the list just gets longer,
You teach math while you cook,
Sip cold coffee, try to feel stronger.

[Chorus]

Did you sign the paper?
Did you pack the snack?
Did you send the invoice?
Did you call them back?
You’re a superhero—just on mute,
Trading capes for yoga pants and a wifi dispute.

[Verse 2]

Meetings on mute while cartoons echo through the wall,
The fridge is empty, the plants have started to crawl,
To-do lists on sticky notes turn into origami birds,
You laugh it off, but sometimes the punchline hurts.

[Bridge]

Can you hold this world together?
With glue sticks and leftover dreams?
Is self-care just a sticker
On a bottle of anti-bac cream?

[Chorus]

Did you sign the paper?
Did you pack the snack?
Did you send the invoice?
Did you call them back?
You’re a superhero—just on mute,
Trading capes for yoga pants and a wifi dispute.

[Outro]

One deep breath before you restart,
You love them wildly—exhausted heart.
Repeat, repeat, repeat.

Locker hall noise, cheap backpack straps
Flyers for bands on bathroom maps
I keep my head down past the crowd
Their laughter always way too loud

She walks by with a silver ring
Friends like a careless summer swing
I say nothing, just let her pass
Name half-carved in my math class glass

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m orbiting outside the light
Watching worlds that never collide

[Chorus]
I’m the kid on the far-off line
Radio heart, bad reception time
Calling out through a busted sky
Hoping someone hears reply
If she ever turns my way
I might find the words to say
Till that day I drift alone
Static voice on a borrowed tone

[Verse 3]
Cafeteria rumors spread
Stories growing in my head
They say she’s dancing every night

But once she laughed at something dumb

Just one second, clear and true
Like the world cracked open through

Maybe I’m just background air
Maybe no one sees me there

Two strange signals might align

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m orbiting outside the light

[Final Chorus]
I’m the kid on the far-off line
Radio heart, bad reception time

[Intro]
[soft finger snaps, four voices swell in warm close harmony with gentle Foxtex tape hiss and distant Mellotron boy's choir]
Pow, pow, pow.
Ba-da-ba-da...
Good morning.
Pow, pow, pow!

[Verse 1]
[bright nylon acoustic guitar with jangly Jazzmaster layers, mid-tempo bossa nova clave fused with tropicália congas, crisp collegiate harmonies over lo-fi warmth]
The coffee's hot, the window's wide.
I'm glad to have you on my side.
The rain has stopped, the street is dry,
There's not a cloud left in the sky.
Open up the door,
Step out on the floor.

[Chorus]
[full band drives in with upbeat samba rhythm, thick wall-of-sound four-part harmonies, percussive vocal pow pow pow interjections, Mellotron strings and subtle New Order synth pulse, dreamy jangle shimmer]
Pow, pow, pow!
Watch the blue turn into gold.
Pow, pow, pow!
Something new is taking hold.
I don't need a reason, I don't need a rhyme,
I just need to see you smiling one more time.
Ba-da-ba-dop, stay right here,
Make the empty disappear!

[Verse 2]
[bass and drums lock in tighter with xylophone accents and slide guitar, vocals playful and bouncy, staccato consonants pop against the groove, Foxtex four-track hiss and dusty dollar-bin warmth]
The paper's on the bottom step.
I've got a little extra pep.
I used to worry, used to fret,
About the things that haven't happened yet.
But looking at your face,
Everything's in place.

[Chorus]
[lush layered harmonies build with Chamberlin strings and indie surf reverb, full percussive vocal punches, driving rhythm section, soft rock warmth]
Pow, pow, pow!
Watch the blue turn into gold.
Pow, pow, pow!
Something new is taking hold.
I don't need a reason, I don't need a rhyme,
I just need to see you smiling one more time.
Ba-da-ba-dop, stay right here,
Make the shadows disappear!

[Bridge]
[stripped back to soft piano, close-mic'd four voices blending intimately, prominent analog tape saturation and gentle Mellotron boy's choir, dreamy shimmer]
(Ooooh...)
It's a simple thing to say,
But I'm happy it's today.
No more looking back at where we've been,
Just let the morning in.
[voices build in rapid ascending scale with tight harmonies and subtle tropicália percussion]
Let it in, let it in, let it in!
Pow!

[Verse 3]
[full joyous energy returns, triumphant four-part harmony wall with jangly Jazzmaster, bright horns optional, congas, xylophone and slide guitar, upbeat driving rhythm section]
So take my hand and walk with me.
There's so much more for us to see.
The world is waking, loud and bright,
And everything is gonna be alright.
Give it all you got,
Right here on the spot!

[Outro]
[pow pow pow chant under soaring lead with call-and-response, harmonies fade into warm tape saturation, Mellotron strings and dusty dollar-bin reverb tail]
(Group:) Pow, pow, pow! (Good morning, sunshine!)
(Group:) Pow, pow, pow! (It's a brand new day!)
(Group:) Pow, pow, pow! (Don't let it slip away!)
Ba-da-ba-dop, ba-da-da-da...
[all voices together, one final tight punch with EMT plate reverb and soft New Order synth pulse]
POW!

[End]

> This song is about my family —
a reflection on love, warmth, and the quiet gratitude that connects us across time and distance.


Hey, you know,
always.
Our little mischiefs—
you watched them from afar.

Hey, you know,
always,
our futures too—
you watched them from afar.

Always,
you were kind,
sometimes strict,
sometimes warm—
that’s how you were, right?

But… I’m sorry.
I wasn’t the ideal I wanted to be.
Most days, I felt too shy to say it.
But today,
I think I finally can.

Just a little bit of the love you gave me,
just a little of the smile you shared.
With the sweetness and warmth of caramel,
I send it, I send it—up to the sky today.

Just a little bit of the voice you gave me,
just a little of your warmth.
With the scent and kindness of caramel,
I send it, I send it—
I hope it reaches you today.

The today you gave me—
I’ll live it again today.
I’ll share it with someone,
and say itadakimasu once more…

An infinite cycle
Ever evolving and constantly changing...
It changes to always remain the same, repeating the same idea...
but in different ways...

Repeating every possible opportunity hundreds of times...
It always repeats itself every time a new trend is created...
The stereotype is always lurking...
It doesn't belong to the original, nor to the common thought.




It makes many choices
But no matter what you do
Your decisions will always remain the same...
In every possible way...

Never change your originality based on your heart's desires.
Change your personality just because the purpose of life
Is just trying to succeed in the same way.

And people have different ideas about life
Everyone is different
And our dreams get bigger
But one thing has changed
We will do everything that seems no longer important, 
to be happy...
to be happy...

A grimy cloth, it clings to me,
The city crushes every dream.
My chest is hollow, heart is numb,
I’m tired of fighting just to run.

raw_sp:
🎵 "Mend Me with Your Heart"

(Post-grunge / hard rock ballad — Breaking Benjamin, Seether, 3 Days Grace style)

[Intro]
(Distorted guitar fade-in, heartbeat drums)
Yeah…
You found me in the dark…
Still bleeding from the past…

[Verse 1]
I was a ghost in my own skin,
Shattered pieces, locked within.
You didn’t run — you reached inside,
Pulled out the pain I tried to hide.

Every scar you traced with care,
Like you’d been broken too somewhere.
Didn’t need to fix what fell apart,
You just gave me your whole heart.

[Pre-Chorus]
You didn’t say a word — you just stayed,
And somehow the fear began to fade.

[Chorus]
You mend my broken heart,
By giving me yours.
You bleed where I’m torn apart,
And I feel it restore.
We’re twisted souls that found their spark,
In all this dark —
You mend me with your heart.

[Verse 2]
Your touch burns through my disguise,
Lights the ashes in my eyes.
You made me feel what I forgot,
That love’s not pain — it’s worth the shot.

[Pre-Chorus]
And every time I start to fall,
You catch me through it all.

[Chorus]
You mend my broken heart,
By giving me yours.
You bleed where I’m torn apart,
And I feel it restore.
We’re twisted souls that found their spark,
In all this dark —
You mend me with your heart.

[Bridge – Heavy guitars / scream layer optional]
I was nothing but the wreck you found,
But you pulled me up from the underground.
Your love’s the fire that scars can’t kill,
You’re the proof that broken hearts can heal.

[Final Chorus]
You mend my broken heart,
By giving me yours.
You’re the calm in the war,
The storm I adore.
Yeah, we’re torn, but we’re never apart —
You mend me…
You mend me with your heart.

[Outro – fading echo, whispered line]
…You mend me with your heart.

title: de dentro de mim

genre: Bossa Nova

instrument_cues: Introdução – guitarra suave, baixo entrando gradualmente
Refrão – guitarra suave e melódica com percussão leve
Verso 2 – voz quase sussurrada, guitarra com dedilhado de Bossa Nova

dynamics_cues: Refrão – crescendo suave, acordes de guitarra mais rítmicos

raw_tags: Bossa Nova
raw_sp:
[Introdução – guitarra suave, baixo entrando gradualmente]
Chorei por dois dias sem saber porquê,
uma assinatura num pedaço de papel
e um vulcão dentro de mim.

O mundo não mudou, mas minha alma sim,
e me vi vazio, tremendo, vivo.

[Verso 1]
Eu era uma rocha, dura, firme,
e amoleci com o tempo,
a água dentro de mim escapa,
mas em sua fuga deixa flores no deserto.

Senti a dor na minha lateral,
como se algo estivesse se quebrando,
e ainda assim, continuo de pé,
deixando minha marca no silêncio.

[Refrão – guitarra suave e melódica com percussão leve]
Do fundo de mim, esta voz nasce,
sem filtro, destemida, sem cor.

Para que quem a ouça se lembre do que significa ser humano,
que éramos fogo, que éramos irmãos.

E se um dia eu partir, minha canção permanecerá,
uma faísca de alma, um eco de amor.

[Verso 2 – voz quase sussurrada, guitarra com dedilhado de Bossa Nova]
Não tenho ódio, nem ressentimento,
apenas clareza em meio à dor.

O tempo me quebrou,
mas também me ensinou
que crescer não é sobre vencer,
é sobre aceitar o que se quebra e seguir em frente.

[Refrão – crescendo suave, acordes de guitarra mais rítmicos]
Do fundo de mim, esta voz nasce,
sem filtros, destemida, pura.

Para que quem a ouça se lembre da nossa humanidade,
que éramos fogo, que éramos irmãos.

E se um dia eu partir, minha canção permanecerá,
uma faísca de alma, um eco de amor.

[Ponte – guitarra arpejada, voz intimista]
Talvez este choro seja a vida,
talvez o vazio seja uma semente.

Não o compreendo, mas escrevo,
porque escrever me sustenta,
e sustentar-me é acreditar.

[Final – voz solo, guitarra suave, suspiro final]
Toquei um lugar profundo,
e, no fundo, estou em paz.
